reviews.title: Re-verify AS3 Areas 1-7 against current code and shared tests
reviews.summary: Executable audit of AS3 Areas 1-7 demotes unimplemented stubs, ignored options, dead setter bags and unsupported throwers to missing or partial, and documents notes on existing partial entries. Array prototype and AS3 lifecycle verification rely on merged T-011 and T-010 commits.
